description: The tab bar of the phone shell (DESIGN.md, TabBar, Screen): glass, at least TsuyaSize.dock tall, TsuyaRadius.lg, items sharing its width equally; each an icon over a TsuyaType.micro label (one line, ellipsis). The current tab draws its icon in the accent, its label at weight 700, over a TsuyaColors.fillStrong capsule. One tab stop: arrows move focus; Enter, Space or a press choose (choosing a tab changes the screen, so moving focus alone does not). A press on the already-current tab instead scrolls the nearest PrimaryScrollController to the top (instant under reduced motion) — Screen sets one up around its own content. While current is null, the first tab counts as current. Put it in a Screen's `dock`.

constructors.description: A bar over items, current chosen; label names the bar itself for screen readers, if it needs one.

params.name: current
params.description: The current tab's value; the first tab counts as current while this is null.

params.name: onSelect
params.description: Called with a tab's value when it is chosen (never on a focus move, and not when the current tab is pressed again — that scrolls to the top instead).

params.name: label
params.description: The bar's own accessible name, if it needs one; Svelte's forwards one the same optional way.
